rows.en: Operation: Kill Kikaider!
Operation: Kill Kikaider? Hmph, don't make me laugh! I'm the one who'll destroy Kikaider!

Wait, Hakaider!

Shadow Knight… With this Operation: Kill Kikaider of yours, just how do you intend to defeat Kikaider and his kind?

Even Kikaider and his lot are sure to have weaknesses!

We'll strike at their flaws: Kikaider's incomplete Conscience Circuit, and Zero-One, who is strong against evil but weak against women and children!

That is Operation: Kill Kikaider!
Very well… But when it succeeds, what is it you want, Shadow Knight?

Just what I'd expect of Professor Gill! You get straight to the point…

I've heard rumors that the blueprints for DARK's giant robot, the mightiest in the world, are complete… Our Shadow wishes to join in its joint development with the robot empire, the Iron Mask Party.

You mean Giant Devil?

Fufufu… I might consider it! But that… comes after Kikaider and his kind have been disposed of!
Don't forget those words… I'll show you the power of our Shadow!
Hello…
Oh, Mitsuko and Masaru… Good to see you looking well.
Oh, you're the one who looks a little down, Mr. Tachibana. Where is everyone?
Narita… Everyone's gone to Narita Airport.
My, is everyone going on a trip abroad?

I wish…

The truth is… Takeshi and Hayato are going abroad to chase down the overseas branches of the new organization, Destron. Everyone's seeing them off.

I see…

Actually, I happened to be nearby, so…
That's nice of you… dropping by especially.
Sis is looking for Taeko.
Taeko? The daughter of Dr. Araki, who made that Conscience Circuit?
Yes… It seems she runs a hotel around here…
Come to think of it… she did mention something like that.
Whoa… a big cactus! Is it real?

Oh, right, I forgot!

I thought I'd brighten up the shop a bit. I went to the florist to get a houseplant or something…

I'm sure I bought a Happiness Tree, but this cactus is what they delivered. I was going to give them a piece of my mind later!
It's so big… But it's rather lovely.
Oh, you think so? Actually… I was just starting to think so myself.
Oh?
Jiro!! Jiro, what's wrong?
Looks like I was shot with an arrow coated in corrosive bacteria…
I'll take you apart and clean you!
T-t-take him apart? This is serious.
Taaah!! Ohohohohoho…

She's good! If she's an enemy… she's a dangerous one!

What are you?
My name is Bijinder!
Bijinder? Are you with DARK?
Ohohohohoho… Bijinder Laser!!
Whoa!
Taaah!!

Bijinder…

Is she an enemy? Or an ally?
DARK's Destruction Squad!?
Hehehe… Number 13!! I'm a Shadow Robot, Red-Face Turtle!
A Shadow Robot?
Don't bother fighting me! You've got no chance of winning!
What!? Kikaider 01 is a warrior of justice.
Hihihi… You want to die that badly? Then I'll grant your wish.

Whoa…

My Red-Face Boomerang has never lost, not once… Damn!
Again?

Taaah!

I'm a robot born in Shadow! And my mission… is to kill you, Zero-One!

But for today, I have no intention of fighting you, Zero-One. I'll be taking Red-Face Turtle with me.
Taaah!!
Bijinder… an enemy after all?
That should do it… You're all right now.

Listen, Jiro… I heard from Dr. Araki…

If I go to his daughter, Taeko, I can get the Conscience Circuit blueprints.

I can't bear to watch you end up like this again and again because of that incomplete Conscience Circuit…

You're the only one who knows where the blueprints are!

DARK doesn't even know who Taeko is or where she lives!

Most likely… DARK is tracking your movements! If you go to her, she'll become a target too.

But… I want you to become a strong android who won't lose to anyone, Jiro!

Don't you remember how many times you've been in danger because of that incomplete Conscience Circuit?

I'm fine the way I am!

My Conscience Circuit can stay incomplete…

I don't want innocent people dragged into danger for my sake!
Jiro!!
Now, be good and go back to the TDF! See you…
What's with Jiro… He didn't have to put it like that. Can't he understand how Mitsuko feels?
Sis…
I heard it, I heard it all! Fufufufufu…

…!?

What's wrong?
Help me… My chest… my chest… ah…

Hey… what are you doing in a place like this?

It's too dangerous around here for a woman to be walking alone.
I know.
Hm? You know?
I don't matter. But I don't want to cause trouble for anyone else, if I can help it…
I'm Ichiro… And you?
Mari…

…!?

A scream!
Excuse me, please help us!
Are you a Shadow Robot too?
Hehehe… Number 37, Hell Kappa!

Hell Kappa?

Picking on women and children, you dirty coward! I won't forgive you!

Mari, take care of them for me!
Uoooh!! Why, you insolent…!? You'll pay for this!
It's all right now!
Thank you so much…
Thank you, mister!
What's your name, kiddo?
Akira…
Mm… And what's your father's name?

uncertain: U04496/U04538: ゼロワン rendered 'Zero-One' (spoken name of Kikaider 01).
U04514: 幸福の木 rendered 'Happiness Tree' (dracaena).
U04523/U04529: Bijinder referred to as 'she' (female android, ohoho laugh).
U04552: speaker 倒れていた女 (Collapsed Woman) is the DARK android later named Violet Sazae.

new_names.why: following ビジンダーレザー = Bijinder Laser
